Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 33768 of 2023

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Kuldeep
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Daya Shankar Singh,Sanjeev Kumar Khare,Saurabh Basu Counsel for Opposite Party :- Babita Upadhyay,G.A.,Virpratap Singh Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1. None appeared on behalf of the informant even in revised call.

2. Heard Shri Saurabh Basu, learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Manoj Kumar Singh, learned AGA for the State-respondent and Ms. Babita Upadhyay, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the High Court Legal Services Committee.

3. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.52 of 2023, under Sections 376-D(A), 506 IPC and Sections 5(G)/(6) POCSO Act, Police Station Sirsakalar, District Jalaun, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged on 20.03.2023 against applicant and two others and according to the FIR, co-accused Mohit Thakur has taken the victim i.e. informant of the case in a forest and committed rape upon her and thereafter applicant and co-accused Mohit S/o Jeet Singh also committed rape upon her.

sentences.text:
5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that entire allegation levelled against the applicant is totally false and very casually alongwith co-accused Mohit and Mohit Thakur, he has been made accused in present case like gang rape.
6.
He further submits that applicant never committed rape upon the victim.

7. He further submits that actually father of the victim was doing work in the house of one Ravindra Singh and he alongwith Ranveer Singh and others committed the murder of his brother i.e. uncle of the victim and father of the victim in this regard lodged an FIR against them including Ranveer Singh and in that case, they have been convicted and only due to this reason, applicant alongwith others has been made accused in the present matter.

8. He further submits that however bail application of co-accused Mohit Thakur has been dismissed by this Court vide order dated 06.12.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.52309 of 2023 but law is settled, there can be no parity of bail rejection order and the case of applicant is distinguishable from the case of co-accused Mohit Thakur as he was the prime accused, who has taken the victim in the forest and firstly committed rape upon her.
9.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.52309 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He further submits that applicant is having no previous criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 22.03.2023 i.e. for last more than one and a half years.

10. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel appearing on behalf of the High Court Legal Services Committee opposed the prayer for bail and submit that it is a case of gang rape and applicant and two others committed rape upon the victim, who was minor aged about sixteen years and victim herself lodged the FIR and in the FIR and in both the statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., she categorically stated that applicant and two others including co-accused Mohit Thakur committed rape upon her and after considering these facts bail application of co-accused Mohit Thakur has been dismissed by this Court vide order dated 06.12.2023 and therefore, applicant also does not deserve bail.
11. I have heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record of the case.
12. It is a case of gang rape, in which as per allegation, applicant and two others committed rape upon the victim, who was minor girl aged about sixteen years and FIR was herself lodged by the victim and victim in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. reiterated the version of the FIR and after considering these facts bail application of co-accused Mohit Thakur has been dismissed by this Court vide order dated 06.12.2023.

13. Further, learned counsel for the applicant tried to demonstrate that due to enmity, he has been made accused in the present matter but the ground of enmity taken by the applicant in the instant bail application appears to be vague one.
14. Further, law is settled, enmity is double edged weapon, which cuts both sides.

sentences.text:
Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
16. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application filed by applicant- Kuldeep is rejected.

17. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
